definition.originalHtml:
Accumulated Flow or Accumulated Load
The predicted mean daily flow (cubic feet per second) or mean annual load of the constituent (kilograms or metric tons per year) leaving a stream reach that reflects the accumulated mass of the constituent contributed by all sources in the total drainage area upstream of the reach outlet. The accumulated value includes the effects of in-stream attenuation processes in all upstream reaches.
definition.label: Accumulated Flow or Accumulated Load
definition.text: Accumulated Flow or Accumulated Load The predicted mean daily flow (cubic feet per second) or mean annual load of the constituent (kilograms or metric tons per year) leaving a stream reach that reflects the accumulated mass of the constituent contributed by all sources in the total drainage area upstream of the reach outlet. The accumulated value includes the effects of in-stream attenuation processes in all upstream reaches.

definition.originalHtml:
Incremental Flow or Incremental Load
The predicted mean daily flow (cfs, cubic feet per second) or mean annual load of the constituent (kg, kilograms or MT, metric tons per year) leaving a stream reach that reflects only those sources contributed from within the incremental drainage area of that reach. The incremental value includes the effects of in-stream attenuation processes associated with one half of the incremental reach length. Incremental drainage areas are represented here as “catchments”.

htmlDefinitions.originalHtml:
Accumulated Flow or Accumulated Load
The predicted mean daily flow (cubic feet per second) or mean annual load of the constituent (kilograms or metric tons per year) leaving a stream reach that reflects the accumulated mass of the constituent contributed by all sources in the total drainage area upstream of the reach outlet. The accumulated value includes the effects of in-stream attenuation processes in all upstream reaches.
htmlDefinitions.label: Accumulated Flow or Accumulated Load
htmlDefinitions.text: Accumulated Flow or Accumulated Load The predicted mean daily flow (cubic feet per second) or mean annual load of the constituent (kilograms or metric tons per year) leaving a stream reach that reflects the accumulated mass of the constituent contributed by all sources in the total drainage area upstream of the reach outlet. The accumulated value includes the effects of in-stream attenuation processes in all upstream reaches.

htmlDefinitions.originalHtml:
Incremental Flow or Incremental Load
The predicted mean daily flow (cfs, cubic feet per second) or mean annual load of the constituent (kg, kilograms or MT, metric tons per year) leaving a stream reach that reflects only those sources contributed from within the incremental drainage area of that reach. The incremental value includes the effects of in-stream attenuation processes associated with one half of the incremental reach length. Incremental drainage areas are represented here as “catchments”.
htmlDefinitions.label: Incremental Flow or Incremental Load
htmlDefinitions.text: Incremental Flow or Incremental Load The predicted mean daily flow (cfs, cubic feet per second) or mean annual load of the constituent (kg, kilograms or MT, metric tons per year) leaving a stream reach that reflects only those sources contributed from within the incremental drainage area of that reach. The incremental value includes the effects of in-stream attenuation processes associated with one half of the incremental reach length. Incremental drainage areas are represented here as “catchments”.

htmlDefinitions.originalHtml:
Accumulated Yield
The Accumulated Flow or Load divided by the total drainage area upstream of the reach outlet. Units are millimeters per year, kilograms per square kilometer per year or metric tons per square kilometer per year.
htmlDefinitions.label: Accumulated Yield
htmlDefinitions.text: Accumulated Yield The Accumulated Flow or Load divided by the total drainage area upstream of the reach outlet. Units are millimeters per year, kilograms per square kilometer per year or metric tons per square kilometer per year.

htmlDefinitions.originalHtml:
Incremental Yield
The Incremental Load divided by the incremental drainage area of the reach. Units are millimeters per year, kilograms per square kilometer per year or metric tons per square kilometer per year.
htmlDefinitions.label: Incremental Yield
htmlDefinitions.text: Incremental Yield The Incremental Load divided by the incremental drainage area of the reach. Units are millimeters per year, kilograms per square kilometer per year or metric tons per square kilometer per year.

htmlDefinitions.originalHtml:
Delivered Accumulated Flow or Delivered Accumulated Load
Accumulated flow or load multiplied by the delivery fraction.
htmlDefinitions.label: Delivered Accumulated Flow or Delivered Accumulated Load
htmlDefinitions.text: Delivered Accumulated Flow or Delivered Accumulated Load Accumulated flow or load multiplied by the delivery fraction.

htmlDefinitions.text: Delivered Incremental Flow or Delivered Incremental Load Incremental flow or load multiplied by the delivery fraction.

htmlDefinitions.originalHtml:
Delivered Accumulated Yield
The Delivered Accumulated Flow or Load divided by the total drainage area upstream of the reach outlet or total of the "grouped by" area. Units are millimeters per year, kilograms per square kilometer per year or metric tons per square kilometer per year.

htmlDefinitions.text: Delivered Accumulated Yield The Delivered Accumulated Flow or Load divided by the total drainage area upstream of the reach outlet or total of the "grouped by" area. Units are millimeters per year, kilograms per square kilometer per year or metric tons per square kilometer per year.

htmlDefinitions.originalHtml:
Delivery Fraction (definition)
The fraction of the flow or load leaving a reach that is not attenuated or removed by natural processes during downstream transport to a specified downstream target reach. A delivery fraction of 1 indicates that 100 percent of the flow or load leaving the reach is delivered to the downstream target.
For delivered results shown here, the downstream targets represent the South Atlantic coast and the Gulf of America coast of the US.
